description: This topic explains the meaning and examples of input and output devices, the types of printers, keyboard key categories, pointing devices, and the difference between soft copy and hard copy.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is an input device?
mcq.explanation: A keyboard sends data and instructions into the computer, so it is an input device.

mcq.questionText: What is the main work of an output device?

options.text: To enter data into the computer
To give out processed information to the user
To control the speed of the processor

mcq.explanation: An output device presents the results of processing, such as text on a screen or printed pages.

mcq.questionText: Which device is used to convert a printed picture on paper into a digital image inside the computer?
mcq.explanation: A scanner reads images or text from paper and turns them into digital files the computer can use.

mcq.questionText: A microphone is classified as which type of device?
mcq.explanation: A microphone captures sound and feeds it into the computer, making it an input device.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following devices produces a hard copy of a document?
mcq.explanation: A printer produces output on paper, which is called a hard copy.

mcq.questionText: Which type of printer forms characters by spraying tiny drops of ink onto the paper?
mcq.explanation: An inkjet printer works by spraying small droplets of liquid ink onto the paper to form text and images.

mcq.questionText: Which printer uses powdered toner and heat to print pages quickly and quietly?
mcq.explanation: A laser printer uses toner powder and heat to fuse the print onto paper, giving fast and quiet printing.

mcq.questionText: On the keyboard, keys labelled F1 to F12 are known as what?
mcq.explanation: The keys from F1 to F12 are called function keys and perform special tasks in programs.

mcq.questionText: Which group of keys is mainly used to move the cursor up, down, left and right?
mcq.explanation: Arrow keys, also called navigation keys, move the cursor in different directions on the screen.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a pointing device?
mcq.explanation: A mouse is a pointing device used to control and move the pointer on the screen.

mcq.questionText: Which output device displays information on a screen as a soft copy?
mcq.explanation: A monitor shows output on a screen, which is a soft copy because it is not printed on paper.

mcq.questionText: Which device is used to display computer images on a large screen or wall for many people to see?
mcq.explanation: A projector throws a large image onto a screen or wall so that many people can view it at once.

mcq.questionText: Which device allows a computer to take photographs or make video calls?
mcq.explanation: A camera is an input device that captures pictures or video and sends them into the computer.

mcq.questionText: Which type of printer presses pins against an inked ribbon and is often noisy?
mcq.explanation: A dot matrix printer is an impact printer that uses pins striking an inked ribbon, making it noisy.

mcq.questionText: Which set of keys contains the numbers 0 to 9 grouped together on the right side of a full keyboard?
mcq.explanation: The numeric keypad on the right of the keyboard groups the number keys for fast entry of figures.

fib.questionText: A device that is used to enter data and instructions into the computer is called an _____ device.
fib.explanation: Input devices send data into the computer for processing.

fib.questionText: A device that gives out processed information from the computer is called an _____ device.
fib.explanation: Output devices present the results of processing to the user.

fib.questionText: The output that is printed on paper is called a _____ copy.
fib.explanation: A hard copy is a permanent printed output on paper.

fib.questionText: The output that appears on a screen and is not printed is called a _____ copy.
fib.explanation: A soft copy is shown on a display and is not printed on paper.

fib.questionText: The pointing device that is moved by hand to control the pointer on the screen is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A mouse is the most common pointing device used to move the on-screen pointer.

fib.questionText: A printer that uses toner powder and heat to print is called a _____ printer.
fib.explanation: Laser printers use toner and heat to produce fast, high quality prints.

fib.questionText: The device that changes a picture or text on paper into a digital file is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A scanner reads paper documents and converts them into digital images.

fib.questionText: The output device that produces sound from the computer is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A speaker is an output device that plays sound and music from the computer.

fib.questionText: The keys on the keyboard that contain the letters A to Z are called _____ keys.
fib.explanation: Alphabet keys are used to type letters when writing words.

fib.questionText: An input device that captures sound and sends it into the computer is called a _____.
fib.explanation: A microphone records sound and feeds it into the computer as input.

tf.questionText: A keyboard is an output device.
tf.explanation: A keyboard is an input device because it enters data into the computer.

tf.questionText: A monitor displays output as a soft copy.
tf.explanation: Information shown on the monitor is a soft copy because it is on screen, not on paper.

tf.questionText: A printer is used to produce hard copies of documents.
tf.explanation: Printers output documents on paper, which are hard copies.

tf.questionText: A mouse and a keyboard are both pointing devices.
tf.explanation: A mouse is a pointing device, but a keyboard is mainly used for typing, not pointing.

tf.questionText: A laser printer is generally quieter than a dot matrix printer.
tf.explanation: Laser printers are non-impact and quiet, while dot matrix printers are impact printers and noisy.

tf.questionText: A speaker is an example of an input device.
tf.explanation: A speaker gives out sound, so it is an output device, not an input device.

tf.questionText: A scanner is used to convert documents on paper into digital form.
tf.explanation: A scanner reads paper documents and turns them into digital files.

tf.questionText: Function keys are labelled from F1 to F12 on the keyboard.
tf.explanation: The function keys run across the top of the keyboard and are labelled F1 to F12.

tf.questionText: A projector is an input device used to enter pictures into the computer.
tf.explanation: A projector is an output device that displays the computer image on a large screen.

tf.questionText: A camera can be used as an input device for taking photographs into the computer.
tf.explanation: A camera captures images and sends them into the computer, so it acts as an input device.

summary.correctAnswer: A device used to enter data and instructions into the computer.
summary.explanation: Examples include keyboard, mouse, scanner, microphone and camera.

summary.correctAnswer: A device that gives out processed information from the computer.
summary.explanation: Examples include monitor, printer, speaker and projector.

summary.questionText: Difference between input and output devices
summary.correctAnswer: Input devices send data into the computer while output devices give results out.
summary.explanation: Input comes before processing and output comes after processing.

summary.correctAnswer: Output that is shown on a screen and not printed on paper.
summary.explanation: It is displayed on devices like a monitor or projector.

summary.correctAnswer: Output that is printed on paper.
summary.explanation: It is produced by a printer and can be touched and kept.

summary.correctAnswer: Mouse, trackball, touchpad and light pen.
summary.explanation: Pointing devices are used to move and control the pointer on the screen.

summary.correctAnswer: Dot matrix, inkjet and laser printers.
summary.explanation: They differ in how they place ink or toner onto the paper.

summary.correctAnswer: Alphabet keys, numeric keys, function keys, arrow keys and special keys.
summary.explanation: Each group of keys performs a different task on the keyboard.

summary.explanation: The monitor is the main visual output device of the computer.

summary.correctAnswer: It converts text or pictures on paper into digital form.
summary.explanation: A scanner is an input device that copies documents into the computer.

hoq.questionText: A school office wants to print 5,000 examination report forms quickly and quietly every term. Which device is the most suitable choice?
hoq.explanation: A laser printer prints fast, in large volumes and quietly, making it best for many report forms.

hoq.questionText: A teacher says: 'A device that takes information from the computer and changes it into a form people can see or hear.' This best describes the general role of which group of devices?
hoq.explanation: Devices that present processed information so people can see or hear it are output devices.

hoq.questionText: A student records a song with a microphone, edits it, then plays it back to the class. Which pair correctly shows the input device and the output device used?

options.text: Microphone as input and speaker as output
Speaker as input and microphone as output
Printer as input and monitor as output
Scanner as input and projector as output

hoq.explanation: The microphone takes sound into the computer (input) and the speaker gives the sound out (output).
